_comment: Which docs describe which code. scripts/docs-check.mjs fails a commit that changes a matching path when none of the mapped docs changed. Globs: ** any folders, * any name part, {module} the module folder name (it is filled into the docs patterns too). Bypass with a line '[docs-ok] <reason>' in the commit message.

entries.name: API routes
entries.why: Routes, their shapes and errors are described in the API doc.

entries.name: Database schema and migrations
entries.why: Tables, columns, rules, and migration files are described in the database doc.

entries.name: Server actions
entries.why: The action list, permission levels, and registry rules are in the AI system doc.

entries.name: Design system and desktop shell
entries.why: Tokens, components, backgrounds, the dock, and the title bar are in the design doc.

entries.name: Desktop module
entries.why: Each module's screens, rules, and actions are in its feature doc.

entries.name: Deployment and environment
entries.why: Servers, containers, scripts, workflows, and environment variables are in the deployment or security doc.

entries.name: Desktop app configuration
entries.why: The window, CSP, and permissions are security and deployment facts.

entries.name: Dependencies
entries.why: The tech stack table lists every library we use.
